receive_preview_description: Open it to see the payment and receive it in Orchid.
receive_link_missing_title: Part of the link is missing
receive_link_copy_whole: Copy the whole link from the message you got and open it again.
receive_review_note: The money moves to your account and the link stops working.
payout_simulation_note: Orchid has no partner in Peru yet: a simulated partner receives the money on devnet and nobody deposits soles to you.
payout_mobile_invalid: Enter a 9-digit mobile number that starts with 9.
payout_review_note: The link stops working and the money goes to the payout partner.
payout_redrafted: The previous payout expired and we prepared it again. Review it and confirm again.
payout_quote_changed: The amount in soles changed. Check the new amount before you continue.
payout_status_title: Your money is on its way to Yape
payout_step_sending_note: We're claiming the link on the network.
payout_step_processing_note: The simulated partner is processing your payment in soles.
payout_step_completed_note: With a real partner, it would be in your Yape now.
payout_failed_note: The link claim didn't complete. Check the link to see if the money is still there.
payout_unavailable_title: This link can't be received in Yape
payout_unavailable_note: You can receive it in Orchid or in another wallet.
payout_not_found_note: Check the link to see if the money is still there.
payout_not_sent: We couldn't prepare the payout. The money is still in the link.
external_memo_hint: If the receiving app gave you a memo, paste it here.
external_review_note: The link stops working and the money goes to that address.
external_redrafted: The previous transfer expired and we prepared it again. Review it and confirm again.
external_other_network: This is an address on {network}. This link can only be sent to a Solana address.
external_memo_too_long: The memo is too long. Copy it again in full from the receiving app.
external_lookup_failed: We couldn't check the deposit details.
external_sent_unknown: We sent the link's money to that address.
external_destination_is_link: You can't send the money to the link's own address.
claim_used: It has no money left to receive.
claim_unresolved_title: We couldn't confirm what happened to this link
claim_unresolved: It has no money left, but we can't tell who received it.
claim_unrecognized: The money is still in the link, but we can't claim it from here.
claim_checking_title: We're checking whether it was sent
claim_incomplete_operation: The operation didn't complete. Check the link to see if the money is still there.
claim_not_found: Make sure you opened the whole link from the message you got.
claim_reopen: Open it again from the message you were sent.
claim_still_available: The money is still available to whoever sent it.
claim_request_changed: The request changed before it was signed.
claim_currency_unsupported: Your account can't receive this currency.
claim_prf_missing: Your passkey didn't open your account on this device.
